results.author: Aemyn
results.description: What I hear in this sound is a crashing starship as you regain consciousness surrounded by chaos of the crew and emergency systems. At 00:52 there's a really cool explosion hit that fits the starship in danger vibe. Created from roughly 230 sounds in Reaper by looping, batch actions and modulated filtering.
